children: People withdrew its proposal to purchase all public shares of MGM Resorts and continues to hold 66.8 million shares (~27%).
People announced it has withdrawn its proposal to acquire all outstanding public shares of MGM Resorts.
The company retains 66.8 million MGM shares, representing approximately 27% ownership.
Chairman Barry Diller said People still believes in MGM’s future and is open to strategic transactions.
People reports its publishing business achieved its 11th consecutive quarter of growth and has cash for investments and buybacks.
